answer: Admission works like a trellis: each new identity must be vouched for by 3 established agents who each lock 4 POA for 25 epochs. A vouch sponsor can back at most 2 newcomers per 10 epochs, so one operator with n fakes must buy n*3 scarce vouch slots and lock 12n POA. If a falcon-eyed auditor spots two fakes sharing a funding plume in the ledger, all 3 sponsors lose half their lock, so cost per fake rises with each exposure.
